text_block_list.text:
"—The Takarazuka Kinen. A grand race where 
the Umamusume chosen by fan voting bring 
the first half of the year to a thrilling 
close."

Hanshin Racecourse was bustling as usual, 
with spectators packing in just to catch a 
glimpse of the popular Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you for having me today! Please, 
take a look at my running, at my story!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(The cheers are loud—yet they feel less 
directed at me personally, and more toward 
the glorious stage itself.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Without the people supporting us, we 
couldn't even run in a Grand Prix race. 
Just standing here is something to be 
proud of.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Still, that's precisely why... I need to 
do more. So that both those people and 
everyone else will turn around and 
recognize me, saying, "Ah, a true hero"—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I want to become someone like that. I'll 
take another step forward, right here and 
now!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen... I gotta give it my 
all!
